class.name: PuertsEnvironment
class.description: Initialize with a backend and cache pool, keep the environment alive while using its values, and dispose it when finished. Use it and its values on one thread.

method.name: initialize
method.description: Creates a runtime from the backend and initialized cache pool. An idle previous runtime is disposed first; returns ERR_BUSY during initialization, an active operation, or disposal.

method.name: dispose
method.description: Releases the runtime and invalidates its script values and callables. Cleanup is deferred when called during an active operation.

method.name: is_alive
method.description: Returns true while the environment accepts operations.

method.name: get_backend
method.description: Returns the attached backend, or null when none is attached.

method.name: set_error_callback
method.description: Sets the synchronous callback for error messages; an invalid Callable disables it.

method.name: set_warn_callback
method.description: Sets the synchronous callback for warning messages; an invalid Callable disables it.

method.name: set_info_callback
method.description: Sets the synchronous callback for information messages; an invalid Callable disables it.

method.name: eval
method.description: Executes code and wraps its result. Returns null on failure; use the wrapper type checks for a successful null or undefined result.

method.name: set_global
method.description: Converts value and assigns it to the named script global. A value from another environment is rejected.

method.name: get_global
method.description: Returns the named global as a PuertsScriptValue, or null when the read fails.

method.name: tick
method.description: Runs one update step for V8 or Node.js.

method.name: low_memory_notification
method.description: Notifies V8, Node.js, or QuickJS of memory pressure; collection is backend-controlled.

method.name: open_debugger
method.description: Opens the V8 or Node.js inspector on port.

method.name: debugger_tick
method.description: Processes inspector traffic for V8 or Node.js; returns false when unsupported.

method.name: terminate_execution
method.description: Requests termination of the current script on supported backends.
